item.title: Where Are All the LITTLE GREEN MEN? (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Dr. Terry M. Adair, DDS, is an oral and maxillofacial radiologist, author, and researcher whose interests explore the fascinating connections between science, energy, and humanity's place in the universe. After earning his dental degree from the University of California, San Francisco, in 1987, he spent more than 26 years practicing dentistry before specializing in oral and maxillofacial radiology at the University of Florida. A lifelong enthusiast of physics, cosmology, and evolutionary biology, Dr. Adair is the author of Where Are the Little Green Men?, a thought-provoking examination of the Fermi Paradox. His proposed Adair Hypothesis explores whether the greatest obstacle facing advanced extraterrestrial civilizations may not be intelligence or technology, but the ability to maintain sustainable energy systems over extraordinary periods of time.

Through his Fusion Star Project, Dr. Adair advocates for greater energy literacy, sustainable technological development, and global energy independence. His work challenges conventional thinking about extraterrestrial intelligence, the survival of advanced civilizations, and the energetic limitations that may determine humanity's future among the stars. Currently residing in Lake Tahoe, Nevada, Dr. Adair balances his scientific and literary pursuits with an active outdoor lifestyle and a passion for exploring life's biggest mysteries. His central message is that understanding energy may be the key to understanding not only our own civilization's future, but why the universe appears so strangely silent.

Spaced Out Radio is your nightly source for alternative information, starting at 9pm Pacific, 12am Eastern.  We broadcast LIVE every night.
